overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation on any of three allegations: a Labor Day meeting, a locked building, and a location differing from the notice. It ordered no remedy and discouraged the holiday allegation as frivolous.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee violated the Open Meeting Law by convening a meeting on a legal holiday (Labor Day).
allegations.key_passage: Holding a meeting on a legal holiday does not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the meeting was held in a locked building, so the public could not access it.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Committee posted signage informing members of the public how to access the meeting location and we therefore find that the meeting location was sufficiently accessible.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the meeting was held at a location other than the one listed on the meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: The Committee chair stated to our office that the meeting was held in Ashland Town Hall as advertised, and the complainant has provided no evidence to support this allegation.
